landing.heading: Check every request against the owner's rules before you act.
landing.lead: Refunds, lesson changes and payment extensions are checked the moment they come in, then sent to the right person with the reason attached.
landing.point1: Every outcome shows the rule behind it, so nobody acts on a guess.
landing.point2: Owners decide on the hard cases. Admins handle the rest.
landing.point3: Safety and welfare concerns always reach the owner first.
landing.notConfigured: The server has no Supabase settings yet. Add SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY as described in README.md.
landing.demoText: Two fictional demo accounts exist: an administrator (Sarah) and the owner (Alex). Whoever set up this copy of the app chose their passwords, so ask them for the details. Passwords are not stored in the code.
